goal.short: Keep Cheng Jung satisfied, so that what is known stays hidden.
goal.long: Keep Koharu Kim in debt for as long as it is useful.

goal.short: Warn Li He of any trouble before it reaches them.
goal.long: Reach the top of Craft Guilds by the long road, one earned favour at a time.

goal.short: Prove to Parvati Chaudhary that they are worth a bigger cut.
goal.long: Rise past Mamata Prasad in Craft Guilds on their own merit, owing no one for the climb.
